verdict.rationale: Brevo's developer docs describe API sends of customized emails to multiple recipients in one request (up to 1000 versions) and scheduling emails for a future time. Its MCP integration also claims campaign management from AI tools through standardized endpoints. However, the documented API scheduling appears to sit in the transactional-email context, and no evidence shows a dedicated marketing-campaign create/schedule endpoint. Missing for 10: an explicitly documented campaign/broadcast creation endpoint, documented campaign scheduling via the API, and independent hands-on corroboration of a dashboard-free campaign workflow.

support.subject: As a developer, I can create and schedule a campaign or broadcast entirely through a documented public API, without touching the dashboard

citations.quote: Send customized emails to multiple recipients in a single request.
Schedule emails to be sent at a specific time in the future.
Manage campaigns and contacts directly from ChatGPT, Claude & other AI tools
